brief:
Israeli occupation forces launched a sweeping arrest campaign in Hebron, according to Ma'an Wire, detaining both men and women during the operation. Details of the number of those arrested and the stated purpose of the campaign were not immediately disclosed.

The arrests mark the latest in a series of detention operations across the West Bank, where Israeli forces regularly conduct raids in Palestinian population centers.
title: Israeli forces conduct mass arrest campaign in Hebron targeting men and women
